title: Errors you can handle

solution.solution.lua:
function parse_age(s)
    local n = tonumber(s)
    if not n then error("not a number: " .. s, 0) end
    if n ~= math.floor(n) then error("not a whole number: " .. s, 0) end
    if n < 0 or n > 150 then error("out of range: " .. n, 0) end
    return math.tointeger(n) or n
end

function read_ages(list)
    local ages, problems = {}, {}
    for _, s in ipairs(list) do
        local ok, result = pcall(parse_age, s)
        if ok then
            ages[#ages + 1] = result
        else
            problems[#problems + 1] = result
        end
    end
    return ages, problems
end

function validate(user)
    if type(user.name) ~= "string" or user.name == "" then
        error({ field = "name", problem = "missing" })
    end
    local ok, err = pcall(parse_age, tostring(user.age))
    if not ok then
        error({ field = "age", problem = err })
    end
    return true
end

function with_retry(f, attempts)
    local last
    for _ = 1, attempts do
        local ok, result = pcall(f)
        if ok then return result end
        last = result
    end
    error(last, 0)
end

hints: `error(message, 0)` raises the message with no `main.lua:12:` in front of it.
`pcall(f, args...)` returns `true` and the results, or `false` and the error value, which may be a table.
unitTests:
test("parsing good ages", function()
    check_eq(parse_age("42"), 42)
    check_eq(parse_age("0"), 0)
    check_eq(parse_age("150"), 150)
    check_eq(math.type(parse_age("7")), "integer")
end)

test("parse_age raises clean messages", function()
    check_eq({ pcall(parse_age, "abc") }, { false, "not a number: abc" })
    check_eq({ pcall(parse_age, "4.5") }, { false, "not a whole number: 4.5" })
    check_eq({ pcall(parse_age, "200") }, { false, "out of range: 200" })
    check_eq({ pcall(parse_age, "-1") }, { false, "out of range: -1" })
end)

test("reading a list", function()
    local ages, problems = read_ages({ "42", "abc", "200", "7" })
    check_eq(ages, { 42, 7 })
    check_eq(problems, { "not a number: abc", "out of range: 200" })
    local none, nothing = read_ages({})
    check_eq(none, {})
    check_eq(nothing, {})
end)

test("validate raises tables", function()
    check_eq(validate({ name = "Ada", age = "36" }), true)
    check_eq(validate({ name = "Bo", age = 9 }), true)
    local ok, err = pcall(validate, { age = "7" })
    check_eq(ok, false)
    check_eq(err, { field = "name", problem = "missing" })
    ok, err = pcall(validate, { name = "", age = "7" })
    check_eq(err, { field = "name", problem = "missing" })
    ok, err = pcall(validate, { name = "Cy", age = "old" })
    check_eq(err, { field = "age", problem = "not a number: old" })
end)

test("retrying", function()
    local calls = 0
    local flaky = function()
        calls = calls + 1
        if calls < 3 then error("not yet", 0) end
        return "done after " .. calls
    end
    check_eq(with_retry(flaky, 5), "done after 3")
    check_eq(calls, 3)
end)

test("retrying gives up with the last error", function()
    local n = 0
    local always = function() n = n + 1; error({ attempt = n }) end
    local ok, err = pcall(with_retry, always, 4)
    check_eq(ok, false)
    check_eq(err, { attempt = 4 })
    check_eq(n, 4)
end)
